{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate in descending order
top_conversion_rate = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print the result to confirm
print(top_conversion_rate)

# Return the segment name with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = top_conversion_rate.index[0]

# Return the value for confirmation
highest_conversion_rate = top_conversion_rate.iloc[0]

# Print both
highest_segment, highest_conversion_rate"}
